policy_summary: Both official Football-Data pages display 2026-11-27 updates. The data page describes the free CSV/Excel datasets as intended for private individuals only and excludes commercial or data-training products using automated bots, scrapers, or AI. The contact page limits intended use to personal betting or academic research, allows manual access or at most light automated downloading twice per week, and excludes commercial or AI data-training projects involving bots/scrapers.
policy_interpretation: No provider-issued permission exists for automated source capture, frozen inference, or AI model training. The published terms and the absence of an applicable provider grant leave the project scope unresolved. The two-session weekly ceiling is not authorization. The project keeps automated source capture, frozen inference, and AI model training denied. This is a conservative internal control, not a legal conclusion about every form of personal or academic research.
